en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Renaissance facade with arched windows, statues in niches, decorative coats of arms, and ivy climbing the stone walls. On the right is an arched passageway leading through the building. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German, identifying the scene as part of Heidelberg Castle (the Friedrichsbau with the portal to the Altan).
